unparsed.note: Naha has no official list of public smoking places. 那覇市路上喫煙防止条例 (2007): street smoking banned on Kokusai-dori and Okiei-dori (plus City Hall front and the Kencho-mae station approach, ~2.5 km); patrols, guidance -> written recommendation -> order -> 2,000 yen 過料 (enforced since April 2009, QAB 2009-03-27). Elsewhere only a duty to try not to smoke while walking.
City answer (2024): outdoor places incl. Yui Rail station surroundings are not covered by smoking bans; Yui Rail stations themselves publish no smoking places.
No official smoking-place data found for Chatan (American Village) or Onna; no Okinawa Prefecture open data on smoking places.
JT "喫煙所MAP" (CLUB JT) covers private places; commercial site, not used.
